text:
```yaml
name: End-to-End Tests

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]

jobs:
  e2e-test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Go
        uses: actions/setup-go@v5
        with:
          go-version: '1.21'

      - name: Setup Rust
        uses: actions/setup-rust@v1
        with:
          toolchain: stable

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'
          cache: 'npm'

      - name: Install frontend dependencies
        run: |
          cd frontend
          npm install

      - name: Build frontend
        run: |
          cd frontend
          npm run build

      - name: Start Tavern server
        run: |
          cd backend
          nohup ./tavern-server > tavern.log 2>&1 &
          sleep 5

      - name: Get server public key
        run: |
          curl -s http://localhost:8080/public-key > server-public-key.txt
          cat server-public-key.txt

      - name: Build Imixv2 agent
        run: |
          cd agents/imixv2
          go build -o imixv2-agent .

      - name: Start Imixv2 agent
        run: |
          cd agents/imixv2
          ./imixv2-agent --key-file ../server-public-key.txt > agent.log 2>&1 &
          sleep 3

      - name: Install Playwright browsers
        run: |
          cd tests/e2e
          npm install
          npx playwright install-deps
          npx playwright install

      - name: Run Playwright tests
        run: |
          cd tests/e2e
          npx playwright test

      - name: Cleanup processes
        if: always()
        run: |
          pkill -f tavern-server || true
          pkill -f imixv2-agent || true
```
